problem: Subtitle authoring omitted the native layout index, binding new subtitles to index 0 instead of index 1. SVG attachment rejected indentation in the tracked imported SVG asset as noncompact authored XML. Moving an SVG to a new media URI refused native noncanonical relationship XML.
changes: Use the ordinary non-title layout-slot binding for subtitles, retaining the native index and inherited geometry.

Add SourceTopologyPlan::try_add_imported_part_shared for exact caller-supplied producer bytes under the existing source XML audit. Restored-part publication delegates to it without changing its checks. SVG attachment and new-part replacement use it; library-authored parts retain the compactness requirement.

Support replacing empty relationship elements in noncanonical streams by removing the selected range and appending the replacement. Preserve every unselected source byte and validate the candidate graph, lengths, event counts and memory bounds. Refuse opaque child content with a direct fragment scan rather than relying on the existing element-only event count.

Add seven native regressions, two OPC unit regressions, strengthen the existing relationship integration test to verify successful exact-context preservation, and retain a precise opaque-child refusal regression.

Reconcile two native UTF-16LE DataMashup items with the source XML census UTF-8 profile. Their identical 11,106-byte payload SHA-256 is b91251f434c5780de555d11f51616af3f8c0a608af258dc5d18b3360f9c14bb9. These valid producer parts remain unchanged and inert; no new parser refusal is introduced.
Index scoped assertions for pptx-412 and pptx-414 without changing historical fixture-status labels.

verification_scope.placeholders: Native slide2 resolves to Fixture Title Layout 006, then slideMaster1 and its 17 layouts. Title 0, subtitle 1, date 10, footer 11 and slide-number 12 match declared layout slots. Master title/body/date/footer/number indices 0/1/2/3/4 and local geometry remain distinct. Exact master/layout marker IDs and bounds are asserted without flattening them into the slide scene.
verification_scope.placeholder_edits: Slide7 is retargeted to the title layout, its direct title/content shapes are removed, title/subtitle are recreated and title text updated. Duplicate title and missing layout name fail without losing earlier valid edits. Temporary save/reopen retains ctrTitle 0/subTitle 1 and empty inherited geometry. Exact changed-member sets and member-byte inverses preserve all unrelated package data.
verification_scope.svg_lifecycle: Both native PNG video-poster/audio-icon pictures admit exact 634-byte SVG asset attachment, temporary save/reopen, SVG-only payload replacement and detachment. The complete original nvPicPr and timing XML, all original relationship targets, PNG bytes and unrelated members remain unchanged. New-URI replacement changes only old/new SVG members, content types and the owning relationship stream, preserves relationship ID, and removes the orphan SVG.
verification_scope.boundaries: Native SVG-only and JPEG pictures return exact PNG-profile ContentType errors with no staged change. Malformed XML, DTD and multiple-root imported SVGs fail at publication before any output. Retained-source SVG inverses restore the exact prior archive; cross-process durable inverse is not asserted.
verification_scope.opc: Paired-empty and self-closing prefixed relationships with a BOM preserve every unselected source byte. Relationship output byte limits refuse before output. Comment-bearing relationship children remain refused, and existing source/graph/namespace/freshness/resource guards remain active.
verification_scope.limitations: No PowerPoint reopen, rendering, rasterization, media playback, active content execution or refresh. General placeholder rendering/inheritance synthesis and native Zoom/MCE shape removal remain outside these assertions.

reproduction.observation: Before the placeholder fix, recreated native subtitle read back as index 0, expected1.

Imported asset attachment reached XmlPublication::NotCompact for formatting whitespace. Initial slide2 removal also encountered its documented MCE boundary; the positive lifecycle uses the unambiguous native slide7 instead.

New SVG URI publication refused noncanonical relationship replacement. An initial assertion expected malformed imported XML to fail at staging; the contract defers payload audit until publication, which the final test verifies with an empty output sink.

Full suites exposed an insufficient event-count guard for opaque children, an old blanket relationship-replacement refusal expectation, and two previously unlisted UTF-16 native census items. The direct fragment guard and exact supported/bounded assertions pass in the accepted run.
